stem: Why is the setting of the antique store important to the plot?

options.label: A
options.text: It allows Grandpa Sam to try a new activity.

options.label: B
options.text: It displays an old object that Jude and Grandpa Sam both like.

options.label: C
options.text: It lets Grandpa Sam learn more about Jude's interests.

options.label: D
options.text: It gives Jude a place to wait while his mom shops.
